info.title: bicycle.guide — guide registry API
info.description: The published-guide registry (the control plane of the guide business), its taxonomy, and the capability spine joining books × guides × KSAO elements × jobs — read-only control-plane metadata for cooperating repos and agents. Shared-secret auth on every route (see securitySchemes). The same data is also servable, unauthenticated, over MCP at https://bicycle.guide/mcp. Full contract: https://bicycle.guide/docs (repo docs/GUIDE-REGISTRY-API.md).

get.summary: The guide registry — the control plane of the guide business
get.description: Every guide in content/registry/guides.json, decorated with has_artifact / home_domain / home_unrouted / renders_here / domain / agent_readable, filterable by home, status, access, standard, series, category, persona, domain, guide_type, pillar, has_artifact and home_unrouted (all optional, AND-ed). Always returns the full-registry `rollup`, computed over every entry regardless of filters, including the distribution gap (guides homed to a property with no rendering surface).

parameters.name: home
parameters.description: Filter by owning property, e.g. jobframe, peopleanalyst, penwright.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status: on | draft.

parameters.name: access
parameters.description: Filter by access: free | gated. Derived from price, never authored — see docs/GUIDE-REGISTRY-API.md.

parameters.name: standard
parameters.description: Filter by standard: bicycle | life-stage | problem-opportunity.

parameters.name: series
parameters.description: Filter by guide series — the operational grouping of guides made to be used together.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Filter by subject shelf. Matches the primary category OR a cross-shelf tag.

parameters.name: persona
parameters.description: Filter by the audience a guide serves; a guide can serve several.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Filter by life-domain — the layer above the shelf: work | life | play.

parameters.name: guide_type
parameters.description: Filter by guide class: career | capability | book_profile.

parameters.name: pillar
parameters.description: Only pillars (true) or only spokes (false).

parameters.name: has_artifact
parameters.description: Only guides that do / do not have a new-design artifact.

parameters.name: home_unrouted
parameters.description: Only guides whose home has no rendering surface at all.

200.description: { api_version, count, filters, registry_meta, rollup, guides: GuideRecord[] }

503.description: BICYCLE_GUIDE_API_SECRET is not configured, or a generated index the route depends on is missing.

get.description: One guide by slug, decorated with has_artifact / home_domain / home_unrouted / renders_here / domain / agent_readable — the same decoration `GET /api/v1/guides` applies to every row.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The guide slug, e.g. start-a-company.

404.description: Unknown value for a required selector (e.g. no such guide slug).

503.description: BICYCLE_GUIDE_API_SECRET is not configured, or a generated index the route depends on is missing.

get.summary: Search guides, or refuse with the nearest owned
get.description: Deterministic search over registry taxonomy and the capability spine. A miss is a structured refusal (nearest owned guides, normalized missing topic, acquire_queue suggestions when present), never an empty array. No model call.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Topic or question in plain language.

parameters.name: persona
parameters.description: Audience filter. Failing it produces a structured refusal.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Subject shelf filter. Failing it produces a structured refusal.

200.description: { api_version, covered, query, missing_topic, filters, guides[], nearest[], suggest[] }

404.description: Unknown value for a required selector (e.g. no such guide slug).

503.description: BICYCLE_GUIDE_API_SECRET is not configured, or a generated index the route depends on is missing.

get.summary: Cross-book disagreements for one guide — names and provenance only
get.description: Each cross_book tension's name, the books on each pole (title, author, library_id), and the guide URL. No passages, guidance, stakes, or decision text. A book profile with no cross-book tension returns an empty list. Unknown slug → 404.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The guide slug, e.g. start-a-company.

200.description: { api_version, slug, count, disagreements: [{ name, poles, guide_slug, guide_url }] }

404.description: Unknown value for a required selector (e.g. no such guide slug).

503.description: BICYCLE_GUIDE_API_SECRET is not configured, or a generated index the route depends on is missing.

get.summary: The guide program's vocabulary, as data
get.description: Every classification axis: domains (work/life/play), shelves with their domain and live guide counts, series, personas, guide_types, the conventions a producing repo must satisfy, and the unclassified counts. Computed over the live registry, so a stale count is impossible. No params.

200.description: { api_version, registry_meta, domains, shelves, series, personas, guide_types, conventions, unclassified }

503.description: BICYCLE_GUIDE_API_SECRET is not configured, or a generated index the route depends on is missing.

get.summary: The capability spine — books × guides × KSAO elements × jobs
get.description: The join across all four objects: capabilities (guides) × KSAO-grade elements × books, with element→job edges derived from the career-guide role-level convention. Filter elements by min_guides, has_job, role, capability, conflicting, ksao_type, construct_class, has_canon_identity, canon_promotion_candidate, q and limit, or pass capability_detail to return one capability with its elements and books hydrated instead of querying elements.

parameters.name: min_guides
parameters.description: Only elements taught by >= N capabilities — the cross-cutting spine.

parameters.name: has_job
parameters.description: Only elements some job requires.

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Elements required by this job role.

parameters.name: capability
parameters.description: Elements taught by this capability (guide slug).

parameters.name: conflicting
parameters.description: Only elements where non-career guides disagree on meaning.

parameters.name: ksao_type
parameters.description: knowledge | skill | ability | other, from the validated panel overlay.

parameters.name: construct_class
parameters.description: person-attribute | condition-or-outcome.

parameters.name: has_canon_identity
parameters.description: Only elements resolved to (true) / unresolved against (false) a JobFrame canon component.

parameters.name: canon_promotion_candidate
parameters.description: Only elements the canon has no component for — promotion candidates.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Substring match on the element label.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Cap the rows returned (default 200).

parameters.name: capability_detail
parameters.description: Return one capability with its elements and books hydrated.

200.description: { api_version, spine_meta, filters, total, elements[] } | { api_version, spine_meta, capability }

503.description: BICYCLE_GUIDE_API_SECRET is not configured, or a generated index the route depends on is missing.

get.summary: Organizational conditions — identity, label, corroboration, causal roles
get.description: ConditionFrame identity catalog. Each row is a frozen condition_identity_id with its label, guide corroboration count, and causal-role counts. Filter by draft domain/subdomain slug or causal_role. Domain slugs are draft until BG-180's freeze ceremony; SHAPES addresses are not emitted. Names and counts only — no passages, no capability→condition join.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Exact condition_identity_id. When set, other filters are ignored.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Draft domain slug, e.g. organizational-structure-and-culture.

parameters.name: subdomain
parameters.description: Draft sub-domain slug, e.g. organizational-learning-and-improvement.

parameters.name: causal_role
parameters.description: driver | mediator | outcome. Unknown values match nothing.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Substring match on the condition label.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Cap rows returned. Default 100, max 500.

200.description: { api_version, address_status, filters, count, total_matching, taxonomy, conditions[] }

503.description: BICYCLE_GUIDE_API_SECRET is not configured, or a generated index the route depends on is missing.

get.summary: Archived membership-interest submissions for operational reconciliation
get.description: Read-only protected export of historical interest captures. New cooperative marketing capture is retired; this preserves existing records for reconciliation only.

200.description: { api_version, forwarded, deadLettered, count, counts_by_chapter_and_option, submissions[] }

503.description: BICYCLE_GUIDE_API_SECRET is not configured, or a generated index the route depends on is missing.

bicycleGuideSecret.name: x-bicycle-guide-secret
bicycleGuideSecret.description: Authorization: Bearer $BICYCLE_GUIDE_API_SECRET, or the x-bicycle-guide-secret header with the same value. Unset secret ⇒ 503 (fails closed, never open data). Missing/invalid credentials ⇒ 401.
